00064 void WrapUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00065 {
00066     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00067     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00068     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00069     float* lowerSamples = inputs[Lower].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00070     float* upperSamples = inputs[Upper].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00071     
00072     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00073     {
00074         *outputSamples++ = wrap(*inputSamples++, *lowerSamples++, *upperSamples++);
00075     }
00076 }
